articles.title: Storm Soaks the Northeast: 100,000 Lose Power
articles.summary: A slow, powerful storm is flooding the U.S. Northeast. About 100,000 homes and businesses lost electricity, and a marina owner watched water rise inside his building for the first time since Hurricane Sandy.

articles.title: Rare Handshake: Russia and Germany Meet at the U.N.
articles.summary: The foreign ministers of Russia and Germany met face-to-face at the U.N. for the first time since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. They shook hands, but Russia rejected Germany's call to stop escalating tensions.

articles.title: Bangkok Underwater: 12 Inches of Rain Floods Thailand's Capital
articles.summary: More than 300mm of rain fell on Bangkok since Thursday, flooding roads and canals in all 50 districts. A 67-year-old shop owner says the water is waist-high, and the governor warns the danger isn't over yet.
